title: STARLING-01
subtitle: 星际信使
summary: 复古未来主义航行器：陶瓷烤漆、香槟合金与光学青蓝玻璃构成的主角级三维道具。可在网页里实时旋转查看。
summaryEn: A retro-futurist vessel: ceramic enamel, champagne alloy, and optical cyan glass, built to be turned in the browser.

heroAlt.zh: 白瓷机身、珊瑚橙鼻锥和尾翼的 STARLING-01。圆形舷窗里有青色刻度，机身印着 STARLING 与 INTERSTELLAR COURIER，下方是黑色喷口。
heroAlt.en: STARLING-01 with a white ceramic body, coral nose and fins, a round porthole with cyan marks, the words STARLING and INTERSTELLAR COURIER, and a black nozzle.

zh: 一件复古未来主义的航行器道具，名叫 STARLING-01，星际信使。机身是陶瓷烤漆白，鼻锥和尾翼是珊瑚橙，舷窗是带青蓝读数的光学玻璃，喷口是深色金属。
网页里可以实时旋转、看线框，并对照高清主视觉。交付物都在 projects/starling-01/：GLB、Blender 工程，以及 10 秒、768 方画的旋转视频。
档案记下的尺寸：全高 4.88 米，机身最大直径 2.20 米，三片安定面，225 个构件。
en: A retro-futurist vessel named STARLING-01, the interstellar courier. The body is white ceramic enamel, the nose and fins are coral, the porthole is optical glass with cyan readouts, and the nozzle is dark metal.
The web preview can spin it, switch to wireframe, and compare the hero still. The delivery stays in projects/starling-01: a GLB, a Blender file, and a 10-second 768-square turntable.
The dossier lists an overall height of 4.88 m, a maximum fuselage diameter of 2.20 m, three stabilizers, and 225 components.

note.zh: 交互预览和模型文件都在 projects/starling-01/，本页不另存一份。
note.en: The interactive preview and the model files stay in projects/starling-01. This page does not keep a second copy.

alt.zh: STARLING-01 的五向检视：正面、侧面、背面、顶面和底面。底面能看到青色喷口叶片。
alt.en: Five inspection views of STARLING-01: front, side, back, top, and bottom. The underside shows the cyan nozzle vanes.

summary.zh: 约 90 秒的动态图形。瑞士网格、1-bit 抖动、超大字级联，声音是纸、敲击和快门。本站只有开场 12 秒的无声预览。
summary.en: A motion piece of about 90 seconds: Swiss grid, 1-bit dither, oversized type, with paper, knock, and shutter sounds. This site hosts a silent 12-second opening preview.

zh: 这是一条大约 90 秒的动态图形短片。画面用瑞士网格撑开，影像压成 1-bit 抖动，字被放到过大的尺寸，一层层压过来。声音走有机的一路：纸、敲击、快门。
随片静帧上能读到这些段落：Cold Open、Grid Awakening、Breath、Soft Field、Collage、Soft Landing。角标写着 1920×1080、30P、GRID 12 / 24PX、BAYER 8×8 / 1-BIT。
下面的视频只覆盖开场大约 12 秒，从 Cold Open 进入 Grid Awakening。文件是 960×540，没有音轨，由 Remotion 导出。后面的段落用静帧放在这里。完整母版另行保存，不放进这个仓库。
en: A motion-graphics reel of about 90 seconds. A Swiss grid holds the frame, the picture is crushed to 1-bit dither, and type arrives far too large, in steps. The sound is organic: paper, knocks, a shutter.
Stills are labeled Cold Open, Grid Awakening, Breath, Soft Field, Collage, and Soft Landing. The frames are marked 1920×1080, 30P, GRID 12 / 24PX, BAYER 8×8 / 1-BIT.

The video below is only the opening, about 12 seconds, from Cold Open into Grid Awakening. The file is 960×540, has no audio track, and was exported from Remotion. Later passages are represented by stills. The full master is kept separately and is not stored in this repository.

note.zh: 站内是预览，不是成片。完整母版约 90 秒，另行保存。
note.en: What is hosted here is a preview, not the master. The full piece is about 90 seconds and lives elsewhere.

caption.zh: 12 秒无声预览，从 Cold Open 进入 Grid Awakening。
caption.en: Silent 12-second preview, from Cold Open into Grid Awakening.

alt.zh: 浅灰纸底上的圆形 1-bit 抖动，中心几乎全黑，向外逐渐变疏。角标写着 SEQ 01 COLD OPEN。
alt.en: A circular 1-bit dither on warm paper, nearly solid black at the center and sparser outward. Labeled SEQ 01 COLD OPEN.

alt.zh: 十二列网格里散布着竖条纹、渐变方块和小型抖动圆。角标为 SEQ 02 GRID AWAKENING。
alt.en: A twelve-column grid holding stripes, gradient blocks, and small dithered circles. Labeled SEQ 02 GRID AWAKENING.

alt.zh: 深色底上的灰色抖动渐变，右侧有环形，底部是大号点阵字 SIGNAL。画面标注 BREATH。
alt.en: A gray dither field on black, with a ring at the right and the word SIGNAL set large at the bottom. The frame is labeled BREATH.

alt.zh: 粉彩纸底上，三个带硬阴影的窗口用虚线连在一起：同心圆抖动、nothing is wrong，以及一份读数。底部是超大字 soft field。角标 SEQ 04。
alt.en: On pastel paper, three hard-shadow windows are tied with dashed lines: concentric dither, the words nothing is wrong, and a readout. Oversized type says soft field. Labeled SEQ 04.

alt.zh: 浅色网格上，EDGE 四个字沿对角线从黑到浅灰逐级变淡、变小。角标 SEQ 05 COLLAGE。
alt.en: On a pale grid, the word EDGE steps down the diagonal, each copy lighter and smaller. Labeled SEQ 05 COLLAGE.

alt.zh: 大片留白中央，三枚黑方块排成一个小三角。角标 SEQ 06 SOFT LANDING。
alt.en: Three black squares form a small triangle in a wide field of blank paper. Labeled SEQ 06 SOFT LANDING.

summary.zh: 一个全部用代码画出来的 3D 小世界。没有贴图和模型，场景就是一个 HTML 文件。
summary.en: A small 3D world drawn entirely in code. No textures or models; the scene is a single HTML file.

zh: 水车、垂柳、双瀑布、绣球和日落时的凉亭，都由程序生成。地形、植物、水和天空没有使用图片、模型或贴图。
草叶用 GPU 实例化绘制，风在顶点着色器里摆动。水面有菲涅尔和夕阳波光，池塘倒映凉亭与晚霞。光线、天空和雾从金黄过渡到粉紫。成片是竖屏，约 38 秒，环境音也是代码合成的。
技术栈是 Three.js、WebGL 和 GLSL。方向、需求和画面判断由作者来定，代码、渲染与音效和 AI 一起完成。灵感来自 X 上 @keydol123 分享的全代码小世界。
en: A waterwheel, a weeping willow, twin waterfalls, hydrangeas, and a pavilion at sunset are generated in code. Terrain, plants, water, and sky use no image, model, or texture assets.

Grass is drawn with GPU instancing and the wind moves in the vertex shader. Water uses Fresnel and sun glints; the pond reflects the pavilion and the dusk sky. Light, sky, and fog shift from gold to violet. The film is vertical, about 38 seconds, with ambience synthesized in code.

The stack is Three.js, WebGL, and GLSL. Direction, requirements, and visual judgment are the author's; the code, rendering, and audio were made with AI. Inspired by a code-only world shared by @keydol123 on X.

note.zh: 这一帧来自项目仓库。在线场景和成片都在那边，不在本站重复托管。
note.en: This still comes from the project repository. The live scene and the film stay there; they are not rehosted here.

alt.zh: 日落山谷的一帧：小路穿过绣球花丛，通向红柱蓝顶的凉亭，旁边是悬崖瀑布和长着睡莲的水塘，远处树林带着移轴虚化。
alt.en: A frame from Sunset Valley: a path through hydrangeas leads to a blue-roofed pavilion, beside a cliff waterfall and a lily pond, with tilt-shift trees beyond.

caption.zh: 仓库中的一帧：小路、凉亭与瀑布
caption.en: A still from the repository: path, pavilion, and waterfall

title.zh: 最短路径 · 蚂蚁配音重制

summary.zh: 用蚂蚁作比喻的最短路径教学视频。AI 语音按常速重配，旁白只出现在关键节点。
summary.en: A shortest-path lesson told through ants. AI speech re-dubs it at a normal pace, and only on the key nodes.

zh: 这是一条数学教育视频，讲最短路径，比喻落在蚂蚁身上。
配音用 AI 语音按正常语速重做了一版。旁白是疏的，只在关键节点说，不把画面铺满解说。
en: A math-education video about shortest paths, told through an ant metaphor.
The voice was redone with AI speech at a normal pace. Narration stays sparse: it speaks only at the key nodes, and does not cover the picture.

note.zh: 成片还没有公开，所以这一页没有预览画面，也没有外部链接。
note.en: The film is not public yet, so this page has no preview and no outbound link.

summary.zh: 把反复出现的小麻烦收成可以做成很小的 AI 产品的机会。信号和机会分开记。
summary.en: Turns recurring small pains into opportunities for tiny AI products. Signals and opportunities are kept apart.

zh: 这个仓库记录的不是工具大全，而是评论区、工作流和社群里反复出现、已经有人在手动解决的小麻烦。
原始需求信号和整理后的机会卡分开存放。机会卡要写清输入、输出、现在的笨办法，以及很小的第一版。现有机会卡是种子假设，还不是已经验证的生意。
网页已经发布，可以直接浏览。
en: This is not a directory of tools. It records small, repeated pains from comments, workflows, and communities: tasks someone is already doing by hand.

Raw signals and shaped opportunity cards live in separate files. A card has to name the input, the output, the current workaround, and a very small first version. The cards in the repo are seed hypotheses, not validated businesses.
A site is already published and can be browsed directly.

title.zh: MiMo 智能体工作流实验

summary.zh: 一组个人用的中文智能体工作流：每日简报、内容选题、Obsidian 学习复盘。
summary.en: Personal Chinese agent workflows for a daily briefing, content topics, and Obsidian study review.

zh: 仓库里收了三条还在改的工作流：公开信息的筛选和每日简报，面向小红书、公众号和社群的选题，以及基于 Obsidian 的学习复盘。
想看的是中文优先的模型怎么处理长上下文、多步任务、有依据的摘要，以及每天重复跑的个人流程。
公开部分可以在本地跑起来，默认不需要 API 密钥。真正接数据源的部分没有放进仓库，以免带上私人账号。
en: Three workflows are collected here and still being revised: screening public information into a daily briefing, mining topics for Xiaohongshu, WeChat articles, and communities, and an Obsidian study review.
The question is how a Chinese-first model handles long context, multi-step tasks, sourced summaries, and personal workflows that run every day.
The public demo runs locally and does not need an API key. Live source connectors are left out, so private accounts stay out of the repository.
